title: OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background
summary: OpenAI is previewing transparent background support for GPT-Image-2 through its API. The alpha channel gets baked in during image generation, which according to OpenAI beats conventional background removal. A single parameter activates the feature. The article OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background appeared first on The Decoder .
